title: The Achromatic Deep

features.name: threading-loom
features.desc-on-touch: Threads pass through here, each one a colour that meant something. Now they all mean the same thing: the knot has forgotten what it bound.

features.name: dye-pools
features.desc-on-touch: Water that once held colour drains into earth. The pigment leaves; the water remains. Meaning leaches downward.

features.name: faded-cloth
features.desc-on-touch: Strips of what were once brilliant. Now they are all the same pale tan. Distinction has become uniform.

features.name: measuring-rod
features.desc-on-touch: Marked in units that used to correspond to shades. The marks remain; the shades have gone. Measurement without reference.

inscription: colour is just a knot that forgot what bound it; when the knot unties, the colour goes with it

reverie.title: REVERIE — by the cooling dye-shed at the creek's edge
narr: You kneel to touch the water where the colour fled.
Katita's hands were here, holding cloth, teaching you which dyes
set in cool water, which in heat. Her fingers knew colours like
names. She would say a shade and the dye would listen.
Now the creek is just water. The names have gone where names go.
You can't remember if she taught you to see or to let go.

file.name: Colour_Study_Dye_Notes_Undated.txt
file.note: Handwritten notes on natural dyes — but the colours themselves have faded from the paper, leaving only the structure of the observation. The knowledge remains; the evidence is gone.

exits.label: back up to where meaning still holds its shape
toward the monochrome plain where all things learn the same grey
to the loom chamber where threads still remember their bindings
